title: Soggy Dollar
meta_description: Find the perfect Destin, FL vacation rental at “Soggy Dollar”, a luxury 10-bed, 9.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 32 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Bar Room, Rooftop Deck, Elevator & Golf Cart. Book your beach getaway now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Private Heated Pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $100 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 4 chairs and 2 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Short Walk to The Beach - Game Room - 6 Adult Bikes - 6 Passenger Golf Cart With ten bedrooms spread across this beach retreat, this home is a Frangista Beach dream with a private pool, multiple porch levels where everyone can congregate, and a variety of spaces made for games or group activities. The indoors boast a first and fourth floor game room, a dining table for 16, and a 5th story observation deck where you can watch the sun go down. But with the humid temps in Florida, you’ll likely be spending most of your time outdoors in the pool. There’s also a hot tub attached to the pool, and we see no reason why you shouldn’t pamper yourself with both on your vacation to relax and unwind.
